text: User approved mesh publication. Published b9e0553b85113d52fc758747d62ddc0fa343e033 non-force to mesh4s main; normal candidate clone HEAD, local main, origin/main, and live remote match with 0/0 divergence. Public mesh-pin surface JVM/JS gates are running at unchanged ScalaFIM 95fdcbe8e with only the still-local atlas override. Next correction court covers repeated matrix columns, connectivity/coordinate cache separation, deliberately colliding Double weight hashes, and an independent Floyd-Warshall oracle. Generic nonnegative SSSP belongs in graph4s, whose existing DirectedRoutes API currently returns a single-target route; strict mesh intrinsic metrics are not a substitute for arbitrary custom costs.
